reasoning_content: The token is required somewhere. Where is githubPackagesToken used? Perhaps in the plugin applied to a subproject (published artifacts). Let me look at the convention plugins that reference maven.pkg.github as URL. Search all classes for "pkg.github".

cd /tmp; python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile('logic.jar')
for n in z.namelist():
    if not n.endswith('.class'): continue
    d=z.read(n)
    if b'github' in d.lower() or b'pkg.github' in d:
        print(n)
EOF
